findings.note: Nov 15, 2026 RotoWire note: Stutzle scored a goal on 4 shots in a 4-1 win at Pittsburgh and has 25 points (11 G) in 21 games. It does not mention any injury. No report on injuries, lineups, goalies or analyst picks for this Jets game turned up.

RotoWire notes say Stutzle leads Ottawa's offense from the top line and first power-play unit. He got on the scoresheet in all but two of Ottawa's first 12 games. His four-game point streak ended in Vegas in late October, so he does sometimes go without a point.

Game log shows points in 4 of his last 5 games. He went pointless on 1 shot in a Nov 10 OT loss to Washington. He has 4 points in 6 November games (21:56 TOI), cooler than his October pace. On the road he has 16 points in 11 games.

Covers made a pick on Toronto's moneyline at -137 (best price then -146 at FanDuel), rating Toronto a 71% favorite, though it says the Leafs lost 8 of their past 9 with only middling 5v5 numbers (about 49.9% CF and xGF).

Toronto (8-11-2 in the snapshot) lists D Morgan Rielly out plus Sissons, Marchenko, Wood and Blankenburg on IR, and Bobrovsky has a .881 save pct. Chicago (5-13-1, 2.21 GF/G, 4.11 GA/G) lists only Byram on IR.
NHL.com reports Toronto lost all six games of its season-long homestand before this road game in Chicago. The Leafs return home Thursday to face the Kings.

Nov 15, 2026 RotoWire note: Dubois has 12 points in 13 games and stays a top-six center, but his recent production is mostly goals, with 4 G and only 1 A during his four-game goal streak; Washington lost 7-4 to the Devils.

Early-season notes show him centering the Wilson/Tuch line, with two multi-point games in his first three, including two assists in the opener; older news items also show a 'return Saturday' note about 25 days ago, so he recently missed time.

Injury history: abdominal surgery in 2025-26 and a fractured hand in April 2026 limited him to 29 games, though he had 46 assists in 2024-25. One search returned no game-day injury, line or analyst-pick reporting for this game.

Nov 16, 2026 Rotowire note: Terry had an assist in the 6-1 win over Calgary, his first point in three games back from hip surgery. He played both games of the weekend back-to-back, but his ice time is still being managed. He has one assist, a minus-4 rating and three shots so far.

Rotowire notes on this page say Terry skated on the third line and the second power-play unit in practice before his Nov 11 return from hip-labrum surgery. Earlier reports expected a top-six role, and he had 38 assists in 61 games last season.

NHL.com status report: Terry made his season debut Nov 11 after June surgery for a hip impingement and labral tear. Coach Quenneville called him a dependable winger who helps the power play and is used in all situations.

findings.note: Sexton now plays for the Lakers, averaging 2.6 APG. He had 3, 3, 6, 2 and 1 assists in his last five games, clearing 2.5 in three. He was cleared from a head cut and played 24 minutes at Phoenix on Nov 15.

Nov 14 report: Sexton (head) was questionable after needing stitches but practiced fully. He averaged 2.6 assists over his previous five games. His minutes ranged from 11 to 27, which leaves the result sensitive to his minutes.

Sexton is expected to back up Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves, which limits his ball-handling. The page's news feed also lists several recent RotoWire 'ruled out' items for him with unclear dates, so his status for this game should be checked.

ESPN's 2026-27 team leaders list Cunningham at 25.7 points per game in 34.7 minutes on 47.7% shooting. That average is above the 23.5 line, though his career-high 52-point game against Washington pushes it up.

RotoWire's game log shows he swings a lot from game to game. He scored 16, 22, 19, 20 and 14 points in some games and 26, 30, 33 and 52 in others. Before the 52-point game he averaged 15.5 points over two games. No injury or status news for Nov 17 was found.

From last season: Cunningham went 5-for-26 for 16 points in a loss to the Spurs. Another loss to San Antonio last season, also on CBS, saw him score 26 points on 10-for-26 shooting, so his results against them are mixed.
